## Safety Notes

- Credential behavior: No credentials are required for the selected docs-fetching skill. Warehouse, dbt Cloud, and MCP credentials remain out of scope and must use user-owned environment variables.
- Network access: Fetches public dbt documentation over the network and caches it locally when explicitly invoked; no private warehouse access is required.
- File access: Reads and writes local documentation cache files and user-selected dbt project files when explicitly invoked by the user.
- Live action risk: Documentation fetches are low risk, but dbt project changes can affect data pipelines; require tests, dry runs, and least-privilege credentials before live dbt or warehouse actions.
- MCP, background services, and external binaries remain opt-in; do not auto-start them from this catalog row.
- Secrets, tokens, private keys, connection strings, cookies, OAuth grants, and account IDs must not be committed.

## Docs-Steward Notes

- This row is the installable catalog promotion for the matching candidate-corpus intake row.
